description: How many outlets are covering a stock or coin now, against its own normal over the last 30 days. Use it for "how many outlets are covering Tesla right now?", "is NVDA getting more coverage than usual?" or "how much is Bitcoin in the news this week?". Each answer leads with the count, such as "14 outlets, 9 independent owners in the last 24 hours", then how unusual that is. Up to 25 symbols at once. Example: symbols "TSLA,BTC", window "24h".

symbols.description: Tickers or coin codes, comma separated: TSLA,BTC
